text: Plan reviewed by independent numerical architecture reviewer. Adopt one OutputSpec with None/Marginal/Joint uncertainty, closed summary variants, scaled covariance representation, separate retention/kernel policies, and stage1 full-fit reference adapter. Reviewer refinements incorporated: covariance is within-feature/conditional-on-W; stable IDs include units/coding/run aggregation; dependent rows and zero variance valid summaries; marginal cannot supply uncertainty of arbitrary later combinations; selected coefficients require estimability; full-model scratch may remain even when betas are not retained. No implementation started.
